advisors.name: Simplifier
advisors.pitchTitle: Delete 4 legacy session hydration adapters (-312 LOC)

evidence.diffPreview:
- export const hydrateV1Fallback = (raw: unknown) => ...
- export const normalizeLegacyTurn = (turn: LegacyTurn) => ...
+ export const decodeSession = Schema.decodeUnknownEffect(SessionRow)
prPlanSteps: Remove hydrateV1Fallback and normalizeLegacyTurn in packages/opencode/src/session/hydrate.ts
Inline direct Schema.decodeUnknownEffect(SessionRow) at the single SQLite reader call site
Delete orphaned legacy fixture snapshots in packages/opencode/test/session/

advisors.name: Performance
advisors.pitchTitle: Memoize workspace directory tree across tab switches (-40ms/key)

evidence.diffPreview:
- const entries = await scanWorkspaceRoots(dir)
+ const entries = yield* treeCache.get(dir) // Cache.make({ capacity: 32, timeToLive: "5 minutes" })
prPlanSteps: Introduce an Effect Cache.make keyed by canonical workspace root in FileWatcherService
Invalidate individual subtrees on fs.watch rename events instead of full-tree rescan
Add benchmark assertion guarding <2ms warm lookup on 50k-file worktrees

advisors.name: Bug Hunter
advisors.pitchTitle: Fix leaked semaphore lock when subagent aborts during PTY close

evidence.diffPreview:
- yield* lock.take(1)
- yield* closeStream(pty)
- yield* lock.release(1)
+ yield* lock.withPermits(1)(closeStream(pty))
prPlanSteps: Wrap PTY teardown in lock.withPermits(1) so fiber interruption guarantees permit release
Add TestClock fiber-interruption regression test reproducing concurrent child exit + tab close

advisors.name: Architect
advisors.pitchTitle: Split ToolTransportPayload from ToolDomainState via TaggedUnion

evidence.diffPreview:
+ export const ToolStage = Schema.TaggedUnion({
+   Pending: { callId: ToolCallId },
+   Running: { callId: ToolCallId, startedAt: Schema.Number },
+   Completed: { callId: ToolCallId, output: Schema.String },
+ })
prPlanSteps: Replace 6 ad-hoc status string switches across TUI and HTTP routes with exhaustive match

advisors.name: User Voice
advisors.pitchTitle: Preserve trailing newline when pasting multiline unified diffs

evidence.diffPreview:
- const cleaned = pastedText.trimEnd()
+ const cleaned = pastedText.replace(/\r\n/g, "\n")
prPlanSteps: Stop stripping trailing newline in normalizeBracketedPaste when input contains >1 line
Add TUI paste snapshot test covering unified git diffs and fenced code blocks

advisors.name: Contrarian
advisors.pitchTitle: Freeze all refactors until cold-start stays under 80ms

evidence.diffPreview:
+ // Gate CI on cold-start wall clock before merging new service layers
+ expect(bootDurationMs).toBeLessThan(80)
prPlanSteps: Add cold-start gate in CI measuring `opencode --version` wall clock
Defer optional MCP transport schemas until first server connection

simplifier-pitch.text: Sire! Our session hydration layer carries four redundant adapters from the old regime. Give me the shears, and I shall sever three hundred lines before noon!

performance-pitch.text: My liege, the file watcher scans node modules on every workspace switch! Forty milliseconds wasted per keystroke! Cache the directory tree in memory at once!

bug-hunter-pitch.text: Look closely, Sire! When a background subagent finishes while a terminal stream is closing, the fiber leaks its lock! One race condition, caught alive in my jar!

architect-pitch.text: Noble Sovereign, our tool execution boundary mixes transport payloads with domain state! We must erect a proper tagged union schema before chaos consumes the court!

user-voice-pitch.text: Hear the petitions of the people, Sire! Twelve issues this week cry out that pasting a multiline diff into the prompt box swallows the trailing newline!

contrarian-pitch.text: Oh, splendid, five more grand crusades! Before you touch a single line of the v2 branch, ask yourself: what if the bug they want to fix is the only load-bearing wall?

contrarian-interject-windows.text: Touch that path resolver and you will break Windows before lunch!

simplifier-interject-bloat.text: No more schemas! Another abstraction layer is madness—delete the caller instead!

performance-interject-latency.text: And allocate on the hot path?! Your grand design will cost us twelve frames!

bug-hunter-interject-edgecase.text: Careful! If that cache goes stale on a symlink, the bug will multiply!

architect-interject-types.text: Barbaric! Deleting adapters without a service contract invites lawlessness!

user-voice-interject-ship.text: The users care nothing for your marble towers—just fix the paste buffer!
